name: Di'tai'ni
description: Di'tai'ni was the home of the Tai'ni, as well as many non-Tai'ni resident workers. It was two systems away from the Both system.
lead_paragraphs: Di'tai'ni was the home of the Tai'ni, as well as many non-Tai'ni resident workers. It was two systems away from the Both system.
It was aligned with the New Republic and maintained a starfighter base for it.
